subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram slash sessions still resolve to channel=(unknown), causing elevated allowFrom checks to fail on 2026.3.13

question: Which fix shape should own the Telegram slash-session channel identity repair for elevated `allowFrom` diagnostics?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-visible and security-sensitive because channel identity feeds elevated host-command authorization, while existing candidate PRs choose different inference points and are not merged.

options.title: Adopt scoped-key normalization
options.body: Normalize non-agent-scoped colon session keys into the agent store shape before lookup, then add regression coverage and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt static channel inference
options.body: Keep the requested session key unchanged but infer known channel prefixes through a static channel registry fallback.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation choice until a maintainer verifies the runtime Telegram elevated exec flow, not only the diagnostic path.

recommendation.title: Adopt scoped-key normalization
recommendation.body: Normalize non-agent-scoped colon session keys into the agent store shape before lookup, then add regression coverage and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for both sandbox diagnostics and elevated security gating points to steipete-authored work in the relevant files.
